title: Experimental Settings in LLM-Based Program Repair: A Study of Inputs, Tool Access, Feedback, and Validation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17993v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluations of automated program repair (APR) systems commonly report the benchmark, the number of repaired defects, and the tests used for final patch validation, but these items no longer fully specify the repair task presented to a system. Recent LLM-based systems differ in the information supplied before repair, the repository and testing operations permitted during repair, and the feedback returned after unsuccessful attempts, allowing the same benchmark to instantiate substantially different repair tasks ranging from localized patch generation to repository-level diagnosis and iterative repair. We present a framework for explicitly specifying the experimental settings associated with reported APR results. We analyze reported experimental settings from systems evaluated on Defects4J and SWE-bench and characterize each result by its task unit, fault-localization assumptions, initial input, tool access, repair-time feedback, final val

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的程序修复中的实验设置：输入、工具访问、反馈与验证的研究
translated_abstract: 自动化程序修复（APR）系统的评估通常报告基准测试、修复缺陷的数量以及用于最终补丁验证的测试，但这些信息已不足以完全刻画呈现给系统的修复任务。近期基于大语言模型的系统在修复前提供的信息、修复期间允许的仓库与测试操作、以及尝试失败后返回的反馈方面各不相同，这使得同一基准测试能够实例化出差异巨大的修复任务，范围从局部补丁生成到仓库级诊断与迭代修复。我们提出了一个用于显式界定与所报告APR结果相关联的实验设置的框架。我们分析了在Defects4J和SWE-bench上评估的各系统所报告的实验设置，并按任务单元、故障定位假设、初始输入、工具访问、修复时反馈、最终验证等维度对每个结果进行刻画。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个显式描述自动化程序修复（APR）实验设置的框架，通过分析Defects4J和SWE-bench上的系统配置，揭示了相同基准测试在不同输入、工具访问、反馈与验证设置下实际上对应着差异巨大的修复任务。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a framework for explicitly specifying experimental settings in automated program repair evaluations, analyzing systems on Defects4J and SWE-bench to show that the same benchmark can instantiate substantially different repair tasks depending on inputs, tool access, feedback, and validation configurations.
